_comment: ThreePlayerTicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is.

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, one of A, B or C
_slots.{row}: The board row index of the placed mark
_slots.{col}: The board column index of the placed mark
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII board (do not translate)
_slots.{moves}: The comma-separated list of available move tokens like '[4]' (do not translate)

player_prompt.intro:
E te Tagata Ta'aloga {player_id} i Tic Tac Toe a tolu Tagata Ta'aloga.
O lau faailoga o '{symbol}'.
E te faia aai lau faailoga i luga o se papa 5x5 e fai ma se laina o fa.
Laina e mafai ona i luga, i lalo, po o le pito i luga.
Faaulu lau mouve i le faiga '[4]' e faailoga ai le selo 4.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Faʻasologa o le siitia e le aoga. Faaaoga "[cell]" pe afai o le sela 0-{max_cell} .
invalid_move.out_of_range: Numera o le sela e lē saʻo: {cell}. E tatau ona i totonu ole 0 ma le {max_cell}.
invalid_move.already_occupied: Ua uma ona nofoia le sela {cell}.
invalid_move.made_invalid: Na faia e le tagata taalo {player_id} se gaoioiga lē aogā.

game_action.placed: Tagata Ta'aloga {player_id} na tuu lona faailoga ({symbol}) i totonu o le vaega ({row}, {col}).
